svg.aria-label: Sequence a destination with the step-drummer
svg.title: Sequence a destination with the step-drummer
svg.text: Sequence a destination with the step-drummer

g.text: MIDI 1, Preset, with the engine on: pad 30 opens the step-drummer (Synth 1 / 2: the
source view, pad 30). Pads 1-16 = the steps of the half shown, in pairs; bright =
Shift + a step = set or clear its note (pad 7); a touch = listen to it.
Pads 17-24 = the destination of the pitch row: pitch, OSC 2, WAVE, FM, MIX, env →
K1-K8 = the 8 step pairs: each moves the destination on its two steps up or down
from the centre (no change); since RC2 the LED is dim there and brighter further
out. The pair playing is white.
Octave ▲ / ▼ = the pitch / velocity page (since RC2 the velocity page can have a
destination of its own); 1-16 / 17-32 = the other half. Pad 32 = the pitch-vel
toggle (since RC2; bright green): the pitch page also moves the notes by degrees of
With Record, touching a step records it on the step that plays. On MIDI 1 / 2, Shift
+ pad 30 turns the step-drummer off (pad 30 dim).
